name: Kronos
description:
Kronos is a modern, high-compatibility Sega Saturn and Sega ST-V arcade emulator forked from Yabause. It leverages modern OpenGL to offer enhanced 3D resolution scaling and smooth polygon rendering.

Features:
- Emulates the complex dual-CPU SH-2 architecture, VDP1, and VDP2 graphics processors
- Internal resolution upscaling for Sega Saturn 3D graphics up to 4K
- Tessellation and polygonal perspective correction reducing 3D sprite distortion
- High compatibility with commercial Sega Saturn CD games and ST-V arcade ROMs
- Gamepad controller support with analog flight stick and gun peripheral mapping
